summary: Frontend and integration retest at 390x844 as user_avatar_test, using cam_mock_avatar.js and cam_mock_lens.js. Setup: user_avatar_test and its session avatar_tok_test were MISSING from the database, and avatar.test@example.com was NOT in OWNER_EMAILS, so /auth/me returned 'Invalid session' and the review request's statement 'temporarily allowed' was not true. I re-created the user (display_name Marta, terms_version 1.0-2026-06) and the session in mongo, added the email to OWNER_EMAILS for the duration of the test, then restored .env and restarted the backend. Results: (1) 2-shot good pair, body form shown (no height saved yet), filled 168/60 female: PASS. The POST /api/profile/avatar URL includes two_shot=true and the result is 74/64/88 (shoulder 33, inseam 83). 2-shot good pair with height already saved, so no body form: PASS. two_shot=true is sent and the result is again 74/64/88. Backend replay with identical features: without two_shot the result is 76/66/90, with two_shot=true it is 74/64/88. The -2 cm applies only to chest, waist and hips, so it is exact. Height stays 168 from user input. (2) Single shot (fullbody.jpg): PASS. The POST has no two_shot and returns 79/67/91/35/80, unchanged from iteration_29. (3) Stitched image: PASS. 960x1496, same size as iteration_29, so no widening. There is no duplicated garment band. The arm and hand on the hip continue across the seam. With the standard pair (crops of the same source photo) the seam cannot be seen at all: the difference from it29 is <1.1 luma, only in rows 827-860. With a lower photo at 0.8 brightness, the background ramps linearly from 255 to 204 over rows 820-844, giving a soft 24px blend with no hard step. The exposure mismatch is still visible as a horizontal tone band (see design_issues). (4) Loading gate: PASS. With /auth/me delayed by 14s, gate-loading shows 'MY ATELIER' white on black, then gives up after 10.7s (10s axios timeout) and the anonymous Coming Soon page appears. Anonymous '/' shows coming-soon with countdown and owner-login-link. Logged-in owner-like user at '/' sees hero-slogan '"Zero stress, solo puro shopping"'. landing-login-btn 'ENTRA' goes to /dashboard. (5) AuthCallback code review: target is computed before history.replaceState. ComingSoon's owner login redirects to origin + '/', so target='/'. Landing's login redirects to /dashboard. Correct.

issues: The 24px blend removes the hard step, but it does not match exposure or white balance between the two shots. When photo 2 is darker or lighter (common with mirror and room light), a visible horizontal band in the background remains at the waistband (/tmp/it30_dim_seam.jpg). Optional: match the mean luma/colour of the lower frame to the upper frame using a strip above and below the seam, or widen the feather to about 48-64px.

action_items: Test fixture: user_avatar_test and session avatar_tok_test had disappeared from test_database, and OWNER_EMAILS does not contain avatar.test@example.com. As a result, avatar_tok_test currently gets 403 prelaunch_owner_only. If the test account should be allowed, add a documented test-only allowlist or re-add the email, and record this in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
Optional: exposure/colour matching across the 2-shot seam (see design_issues).
critical_code_review_comments: pose.js still has the stale comment 'No reliable anchor: simply stack photo 2 under photo 1 at the same width.' directly above the newer comment (reported in iteration_29 too).

The waistband seam (hipY - 15% torso) applies only when reg.seam === u.hipY, i.e. registerParts or the joint fallback. The no-anchor fallback still cuts at u.hipY and places photo 2's waist at 30% of torso above the hips. This is inconsistent, but harmless.
If /auth/me times out after 10s, the owner silently sees Coming Soon with no retry. Consider a retry, or a 'riprova' link on gate timeout.
AvatarBox.upload default twoShot = !!pending?.shots reads pending from the render closure. That is correct for both call sites (Confirm and BodyForm), but fragile: consider passing it explicitly.
seed_data_creation: Re-created users{user_id:'user_avatar_test', email:'avatar.test@example.com', display_name:'Marta', terms_version:'1.0-2026-06'} and user_sessions{session_token:'avatar_tok_test', 7-day expiry}. OWNER_EMAILS was temporarily extended and then RESTORED to the original value 'andremo2014@gmail.com'. The backend was restarted, so avatar_tok_test now returns 403 again. Final test user measurements: 79/67/91/35/80 (single-shot), 168/60 female. user_389c87aaadc6 was not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To use avatar_tok_test, add avatar.test@example.com to OWNER_EMAILS (backend/.env) and restart the backend. Inline /app/tests/it30_stitch.py in browser_automation; it reads /tmp/upper.jpg, /tmp/lower.jpg and /tmp/fullbody.jpg. Single mode uses avatar-camera-snap-btn (big-snap is only for double mode). Stitched outputs: /tmp/it30_good.jpg; side-by-side upper|lower|it29|it30 at /tmp/it30_cmp.jpg; brightness-mismatch test at /tmp/it30_dim.jpg and /tmp/it30_dim_seam.jpg. Baseline features replay gives 76/66/90 without two_shot and 74/64/88 with it.
